title: Norisuke, Saigyou / Security Network Profile
summary: Withdrawn profile of Saigyou Norisuke and the security organisation through which several individuals, including Kenji, passed during their early lives.
body:
SUBJECT

NORISUKE, SAIGYOU

Saigyou Norisuke is associated with a private security and protection network operating across Monument and surrounding commercial routes.

Available records describe a layered organisation rather than a conventional military command. Norisuke's personal involvement varies by source. Several individuals appear to have entered the organisation through affiliated security personnel rather than direct contact with Norisuke himself.

Kenji is one such individual.

The organisation's present structure is unclear.
